name: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling - Niles Production Plant, IL

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (42.0158,-87.7945, ROOFTOP) are accurate - confirmed 7400 N Oak Park Ave, Niles IL 60714, the Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling Niles production plant and Reyes Coca-Cola headquarters. Confirmed by Street View showing Coca-Cola and Sprite branded trailers parked along the truck yard. Facility opened 1964, acquired by Reyes 2016, 365,000+ sq ft, bottles 24M+ cases/year for the Midwest.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site - the truck yard fronts the public road with no perimeter fence, no barrier arm, no sliding gate, and no guard booth at any entrance. Coca-Cola/Sprite trailers are parked openly within view of the road. Multiple wide open driveway entrances. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere on the perimeter - confirmed across multiple Street View headings. False.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two open driveway entrances into the truck yard counted (one mid-block, one further along) - recorded truckGateCount 2 although neither is a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The site has multiple open driveways serving the truck yard at different points along the road, so in-and-out movement is split across separate openings - recorded entryExitSeparate true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~30 dock doors along the building faces with trailers backed in; banded 25-50. Flagged uncertain - dock face partly obscured by trailers and rooftop angle.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard holds ~35 trailers in marked rows; banded 25-50. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved truck yard between the entrances and the dock doors provides ample internal staging.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open yard easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main production/warehouse building plus a connected south warehouse building plus an office building - multiple large structures on one property.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property evident; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Niles is a dense inner-ring Chicago suburb - Urban.
